correctness.rationale: Every spanning tree of K_{2,n}, n>=2, has one right vertex of degree two and n-1 of degree one, giving n*2^(n-1) incidence vectors. Exact Walsh factorization W(a,b)=sum_j a_j b_j product_(i!=j)(a_i+b_i) yields the opposed-pair cases t>=2 zero; t=1 absolute 2^(n-1); t=0 absolute 2^(n-1)|n-2j|. Their counts give support (n+1)2^n - 1_(2|n) binom(n,n/2). With Fourier inverse 2^(-2n)W, endpoint l1 and linfty convolution norm equals kernel l1, obtained by delta and sign extremizers. Telescoping binomial sums give n/2 + n/2^n binom(n-1,floor((n-1)/2)), exact parity increments and central-binomial asymptotics. Walsh diagonalization gives XOR matrix rank. Independent exact Walsh transforms on all frequencies for n=2,3,4,5 produced (tree_count,support)=(4,10),(12,32),(32,74),(80,192), matching exact moment norms. Infinite proof is symbolic.
